summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Zacatecas Deslumbrante Prototype: an official AI conversational assistant with real-time streaming, bilingual UI (es-MX / en-US), collapsible left navigation panel, 26-source Knowledge Base grounding, collapsible 50/50 Google Maps workspace with interactive InfoWindows and nearby attraction clustering, badge distinction system for history/legends/recommendations, and suggested open-decision itinerary planner.
